words.gloss_range: resumptive or coordinating connector at the entry boundary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative command that begins the Idris reminder unit

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the Idris entry as continuation with renewal: it keeps the prophet gallery moving while launching a fresh command unit. Because it is attached before {{ar:اذْكُرْ}} ({{tr:udhkur}}), the new imperative is heard as connected onset rather than an isolated start.

topics.headline: resumptive opening into a new gallery entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector both continues the prophet gallery and starts a fresh Idris command unit.
topics.reason: The particle evidence and book-reminder refrain support continuation, while the local imperative clause keeps this from being mere syntactic absorption into the prior entry.

topics.headline: attached recited onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the new command arrive as a connected onset rather than as a detached sentence start.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector attaches before {{ar:اذْكُرْ}} ({{tr:udhkur}}), so the command remains syntactically new but phonologically linked.

words.gloss_range: command to mention, remember, and preserve in the local Book-frame
words.root_gloss_range: remembrance, mention, reminder, invocation, and recorded preservation; locally narrowed to an imperative act of mention
words.prose: {{ar:اذْكُرْ}} ({{tr:udhkur}}) is a singular imperative with {{ar:إِدْرِيسَ}} ({{tr:idrīsa}}) as its direct object, so the ayah commands an addressed agent to name him rather than merely listing him. The revealed command performs the preservation it orders: the root range keeps remembrance, mention, and record together, but the local form narrows that range to an enacted mention inside the repeated Book-reminder formula used at 19:16, 19:41, 19:51, 19:54, and 19:56.

topics.headline: singular imperative with explicit object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Idris is not merely listed; a singular addressee is commanded to mention him as the direct object.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:اذْكُرْ}} ({{tr:udhkur}}) as a 2ms imperative, and attachment evidence makes {{ar:إِدْرِيسَ}} ({{tr:idrīsa}}) its explicit object.

topics.headline: remembrance as performed preservation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is an act of mention and preservation inside revelation, not only a private mental recall.
topics.reason: The broader remembrance, mention, and record range survives, while local grammar narrows it to the actual imperative speech act {{ar:اذْكُرْ}} ({{tr:udhkur}}), not to an abstract noun or every ritual register.

topics.headline: repeated book-reminder formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Idris entering the same repeated Surah 19 book-reminder frame used at 19:16, 19:41, 19:51, and 19:54.
topics.reason: The row family supplies concrete Surah 19 references, and the local phrase repeats the formula before the credential clause explains its force.

topics.headline: clipped sound texture
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: Phonetic texture is decorative here and does not change the command, object, or formula analysis.
topics.reason: The row describes sound texture, but after the imperative onset and formula topics are retained it adds no separate interpretive payoff for word prose.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the Book as the command frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite Book complement governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the Book phrase the frame of the command before Idris is named. Its range allows the Book to be heard as container and medium, while the complement {{ar:الْكِتَابِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) blocks a temporal or loose setting.

topics.headline: preposition fixes the Book-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book-frame is fixed before the named object arrives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) govern {{ar:الْكِتَابِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) as the complement of the command, while Idris remains the direct object.

topics.headline: container and medium readings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the Book as both the textual container and the medium of Idris remembrance.
topics.reason: The preposition range survives as container and instrument, but the concrete complement {{ar:الْكِتَابِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) blocks a temporal or loose circumstantial reading.

topics.headline: long-vowel transition
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The vowel observation is not needed for translation, lexical review, or commentary after the frame relation is preserved.
topics.reason: The row gives an auditory observation, but it does not add a distinct lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained prepositional-frame topic.

words.gloss_range: the definite Book as textual frame and preserving record
words.root_gloss_range: writing, recording, prescription, and joined binding; locally narrowed to the recognized text-space of remembrance
words.prose: {{ar:الْكِتَابِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is definite, singular, and genitive after {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), so it is the recognized textual frame, not the object being mentioned. Its record-scripture range lets the command gather Idris into a bound prophetic sequence, and the same Book-frame links this entry to the Surah 19 formula at 19:16, 19:41, 19:51, 19:54, and 19:56.

topics.headline: known singular Book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse presupposes a recognized singular Book, not an indefinite record created only for Idris.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite singular genitive, and the repeated Surah 19 formula supports a stable recognized textual referent.

topics.headline: governed frame rather than object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book is the governed frame of mention, while Idris is the object being mentioned.
topics.reason: The case split places {{ar:الْكِتَابِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) under {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) and {{ar:إِدْرِيسَ}} ({{tr:idrīsa}}) as the accusative object of the command.

topics.headline: record-scripture range with joining image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Book as a preserving record that gathers Idris into a bound prophetic sequence.
topics.reason: The scripture, record, decree, and joining range is locally narrowed by the command of mention; decree and celestial-archive possibilities remain background rather than the selected local function.

topics.headline: gallery container across prophet entries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Idris placed inside the same Surah 19 container that frames Maryam, Ibrahim, Musa, and Ismail.
topics.reason: The concrete references at 19:16, 19:41, 19:51, 19:54, and 19:56 make the Book-frame a repeated gallery device, not a local accident.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name functioning as the accusative object of the command, with supplied {{ar:د ر س}} ({{tr:d-r-s}}) study and effacement resonance treated as non-derivational

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: supplied study and effacement root-field treated as resonance, not derivation

words.prose: {{ar:إِدْرِيسَ}} ({{tr:idrīsa}}) lands as the accusative object of the command, then the assertion resumes him by pronoun. The foreign-name marking prevents a forced Arabic derivation, but the nearby Book-frame lets the supplied {{ar:د ر س}} ({{tr:d-r-s}}) field press in two directions: study and repeated reading fit the textual setting, while effacement makes the command to preserve him in the Book more pointed. Because the name occurs only here and at 21:85, the compact credentials in this ayah carry defining weight.

topics.headline: proper name as command object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the name landing as the object of remembrance before the assertion explains why he must be mentioned.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:إِدْرِيسَ}} ({{tr:idrīsa}}) as an accusative diptote proper noun, and attachment evidence makes it the command object before the following assertion resumes it.

topics.headline: study-name resonance under etymology limits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel a study, repeated-reading, and trace-preservation pressure around the name because it stands beside the Book, while the foreign-name marking keeps that as resonance rather than derivation.
topics.reason: The bundle itself marks the surface as a foreign proper noun with disputed etymology, so the {{ar:د ر س}} ({{tr:d-r-s}}) field can color the local Book adjacency without replacing the proper-name analysis.

topics.headline: rare two-portrait name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a name with only two Quranic portraits is heavily defined here by the compact truthfulness-and-prophethood credential.
topics.reason: The row family supplies the other occurrence at 21:85, making the 19:56 credential clause load-bearing rather than incidental.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus 3ms pronoun resuming Idris

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: full credential predicate sequence under the emphatic particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:inna-hū}}) resumes Idris compactly with a 3ms pronoun and turns the second beat into an emphatic justification. Its scope runs through {{ar:كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā}}), so both credentials answer why the command to mention him was issued.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes Idris compactly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the assertion resume Idris by pronoun instead of repeating the name, keeping the credential clause compact and referentially fixed.
topics.reason: The suffix in {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:inna-hū}}) is governed by the particle and resolves to the immediately preceding named object.

topics.headline: emphatic assertion over both credentials
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two predicates as one emphatically asserted reason for the command to mention Idris.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:inna-hū}}) clause govern the whole predicate sequence {{ar:كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyā}}).

words.gloss_range: perfect copula linking Idris to settled predicate status
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existence, and place-related derivatives; locally narrowed to a copular perfect with forward echoes
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) is not an event verb here; it links the resumed subject to two predicate credentials. The perfect form presents those credentials as settled identity, while the repeated Surah 19 terminal formula connects Idris with earlier entries, especially 19:41. The root family also points forward from established being in 19:56 to raised place in 19:57, and contrasts with negated pre-being at 19:67.

topics.headline: copula turns two qualities into one credential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb links Idris to two predicates as status, not as an event he performs.
topics.reason: The local frame has no lexical object; {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) carries the pronoun subject into the two accusative predicate complements.

topics.headline: perfect form states settled identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the credentials as already established identity rather than future or ongoing development.
topics.reason: The perfect form supports settled or enduring designation in this predicate clause, while the local syntax keeps it copular.

topics.headline: terminal credential formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Idris closing the gallery with the same kind of terminal credentialing frame used for earlier Surah 19 prophets, especially 19:41.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels at 19:41, 19:51, 19:54, and 19:56 support formulaic closure without overriding the local predicate syntax.

topics.headline: being answered by raised place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that established being in 19:56 is followed immediately by raised place in 19:57.
topics.reason: The {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) family connection to place can be retained as forward uptake, but local {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) remains a copular perfect rather than a place noun.

topics.headline: settled being contrasted with negated pre-being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees established prophetic being here contrasted later with human non-being before creation at 19:67.
topics.reason: The 19:67 echo is concrete and relevant to the same root field, while it remains a contrast rather than the governing local parse.

words.gloss_range: intensive truthfulness and confirmation as the first predicate
words.root_gloss_range: truth, truthfulness, sincerity, fulfillment, and confirmation; locally focused as an intensive predicate grounding prophecy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: copular verb governing the predicate sequence
prophetic title following the truthfulness predicate

words.prose: {{ar:صِدِّيقًا}} ({{tr:ṣiddīqan}}) is the first predicate under {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), not a loose adjective beside the name. Its rare intensive form makes truthfulness constitutive and habitual, and its truth-confirmation range presents Idris as truthful in himself and as a confirmer of the prophetic truth named by {{ar:نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:nabiyyā}}), while Form II confirmation remains semantic coloring rather than the surface form. The exact pair also links Idris to Ibrahim at 19:41 and to a wider truth-rank vocabulary at 5:75 and 4:69.

topics.headline: first predicate leads into prophecy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices truthfulness functioning as a formal predicate that immediately leads into the prophetic title without a conjunction.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place {{ar:صِدِّيقًا}} ({{tr:ṣiddīqan}}) inside the predicate sequence under {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}).

topics.headline: rare intensive truthfulness form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truthfulness presented as constitutive and habitual through the rare intensive form, not as ordinary truth-speaking.
topics.reason: The ADJ_INTENS pattern and low occurrence profile support retaining the form-level payoff.

topics.headline: truthfulness, fulfillment, and confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the truth-quality grounding the prophetic credential as both intrinsic truthfulness and confirming relation to divine message.
topics.reason: The confirmation and fulfillment range is meaningful beside {{ar:نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:nabiyyā}}), but Form II confirmation is treated as semantic coloring, not the surface form itself.

topics.headline: rank echoes across the gallery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Idris joined to Ibrahim by the exact pair at 19:41 and linked to a wider truth-rank vocabulary that also includes 5:75 and 4:69.
topics.reason: The concrete references preserve the formula and rank payoff, while the local word remains the singular predicate {{ar:صِدِّيقًا}} ({{tr:ṣiddīqan}}).

words.gloss_range: prophetic title as final second predicate
words.root_gloss_range: weighty news and prophetic communication, with a contested elevation derivation kept as forward resonance
words.prose: {{ar:نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:nabiyyā}}) closes the ayah as a second predicate in the same credential frame, so prophetic status is the final heard reason for the command. The news-bearing derivation makes Idris a concrete bearer of weighty report inside a remembrance command, while the contested elevation derivation is narrowed to a forward link because 19:57 explicitly raises him. The title also places him in the Surah 19 prophetic roster and completes the exact pair shared with 19:41.

topics.headline: final title as second predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word landing as a second predicate in the same credential frame, not as a loose add-on.
topics.reason: The shared accusative morphology binds {{ar:نَبِيًّا}} ({{tr:nabiyyā}}) to {{ar:صِدِّيقًا}} ({{tr:ṣiddīqan}}) under the assertion.

topics.headline: concrete bearer of weighty news
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears prophecy as a concrete news-bearing status inside a command to transmit remembrance.
topics.reason: The noun form selects the person as bearer of the report rather than making reports themselves the grammatical focus.

topics.headline: elevation derivation answered in 19:57
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the title carrying a possible elevation pressure that the next ayah makes explicit in 19:57.
topics.reason: The root dispute between {{ar:ن ب أ}} ({{tr:n-b-ʾ}}) and {{ar:ن ب و}} ({{tr:n-b-w}}) survives because 19:57 supplies explicit raising, but the local surface remains the prophetic title.

topics.headline: prophetic roster and formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Idris share the Surah 19 prophetic roster title while the exact truth-plus-prophet pair links him especially with 19:41.
topics.reason: The local title is categorical, and the concrete references show how the category is distributed through the surah without making those other entries govern this parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "واذكر في الكتاب" at words 1-3 joins an imperative of recollection to a written medium before naming Idris.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recollection makes an absent person present again, while ordered writing preserves that recovery beyond the moment of speech. The verse therefore performs the reactivation of a prophetic witness rather than merely locating a name in a text.

activation_trace.role: A reminder makes something present again and supplies the verse's retrieval operation.
Ordered written signs provide the durable medium in which the retrieved witness remains available.
The office of reporting from God identifies the remembered person as a prophetic witness.

changed_reading.after: Use the written composition to reactivate Idris as a presently available prophetic witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive predicate "صديقا" at word 7 stands directly before "نبيا" at word 8 within "كان".
baseline_models.mechanism: The truth root couples correspondence in speech with realization in deed, while the prophecy root supplies consequential report from God. Their adjacency makes truthfulness the operating reliability of prophetic transmission, not a detached second honor.

activation_trace.role: Being present in time stabilizes the two predicates as an established characterization.
Truthful speech supplies correspondence between utterance, inward commitment, and what is reported.
Realizing a promise or claim in action turns truth from accuracy into performed verification.
A consequential report supplies the content whose transmission requires that verified reliability.
Reporting from God specifies the institutional direction of the truth-bearing function.

changed_reading.before: Idris receives two independent honorifics: very truthful and prophetic.
changed_reading.after: Idris is a truth-realizer whose correspondence of speech and act makes him a reliable bearer of divine report.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The name Idris is placed inside "الكتاب", followed by "كان" and the completed quality "صديقا".
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book can operate as a register, remembrance as durable repute, and being as standing or station. Together they admit a secondary reading in which the verse installs Idris in a recognized, stable rank.

activation_trace.role: Entering a name in a register supplies the formal installation mechanism.
Honorable repute gives the registered name a durable social value.
Place or standing turns the predicate sequence into an assigned position as well as a past description.
Complete and established soundness supplies the criterion for that recognized standing.

changed_reading.before: The Book contains a brief biographical notice about Idris.
changed_reading.after: The notice also installs Idris in a durable register of recognized truthful standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical 19:41 frame opens an Abraham unit in which concerned speech, costly separation, and message-bearing speech enact truthful prophecy. Repetition at 19:56 makes "صديقا نبيا" function as a compressed claim that the identity is narratively enactable even though Idris's deeds are not supplied.

activation_trace.role: Truth realized in action anchors the focus predicate as a potentially enacted profile.
The same reminder construction opens the comparison unit and makes the repeated frame structurally visible.
The same action-verifying truth branch is subsequently unfolded by the Abraham sequence.
Earnest care expressed in speech supplies one enacted form of truth-bearing concern.
Withdrawal to a separate side supplies a costly action that makes the preceding speech consequential.
The tongue as message-delivery gives the unfolded profile a durable communicative outcome.

structural_cues: 19:41 and 19:56 are lexically identical apart from the personal name.
19:42-50 unfolds the first frame, while 19:56 receives only the immediate elevation sequel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact frame identity and an enacted Abraham unit; I infer that recurrence licenses a compressed-profile function, not transfer of Abraham's specific acts to Idris. The live alternative is a purely formulaic catalogue.

changed_reading.before: "صديقا نبيا" is a static pair of honorifics.
changed_reading.after: "صديقا نبيا" is a compressed narrative claim that prophetic truth must be enactable, while leaving Idris's particular enactments unstated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier gift of a high "tongue of truth" joins public speech, the same truth root, and elevation. It activates the focus branches of honorable remembrance and registry, so Idris's truthfulness extends from personal reliability into a transmissible truthful repute carried by the Book.

activation_trace.role: Honorable remembrance anchors the focus as public repute rather than private recollection alone.
Registry supplies the durable carrier that preserves the named person's standing.
Established completeness allows truth to characterize a durable reputation, not only isolated statements.
Tongue as language and speech supplies the public medium through which truthful repute circulates.
The shared truth root binds elevated public speech to the focus predicate's established soundness.
Elevation as honor raises the truthful tongue into socially durable distinction.

structural_cues: 19:50 places "لسان", "صدق", and "عليا" in one phrase before the repeated mention-in-the-Book notices.
19:56 combines honorable remembrance with the same truth root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and a speech-truth-elevation cluster; I infer that it calibrates what remembered truth can become in the Book. The alternative is that 19:50 remains a person-specific gift with no coloring effect on Idris.

changed_reading.before: Idris's truthfulness is an inward moral trait preserved as information.
changed_reading.after: Idris's truthfulness becomes a voiced, elevated reputation that the Book continues to transmit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding Ismail notice narrows truth into fidelity to a promise, then continues with binding instruction and purifying practice. Against that local calibration, the intensive "صديقا" in 19:56 gathers factual truth and sustained fulfillment of what speech commits one to.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment in action anchors intensive truthfulness as performed fidelity.
The shared truth root is explicitly attached to a promise and supplies the local specification of fulfillment.
A spoken promise opens expectation of a future state and creates the commitment that truth must carry forward.
Binding instruction converts committed speech into an ordered pattern of conduct.
Purity and soundness supply the practical end toward which the commanded conduct is directed.

structural_cues: 19:54-55 immediately precedes the focus and uses the same mention-in-the-Book frame.
The form shifts from "صادق" qualified by promise to the intensive "صديق" without an expressed object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, a shared formula, and a truth-to-promise-to-practice sequence; I infer that the explicit case locally calibrates the intensive focus predicate. The alternative is that each named profile remains semantically independent.

changed_reading.after: "صديقا" means sustained fidelity that carries a word through obligation into purifying practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel raises Idris to a high "مكان", explicitly reusing the focus being root as place or standing. Spatial elevation and elevation of rank remain co-present, so the focus's registered truthful standing receives an enacted vertical confirmation.

activation_trace.role: Honorable remembrance anchors an elevation of standing that can coexist with spatial raising.
Place and status latent in being prepare the focus predicate for the sequel's explicit station.
Raising a thing supplies the literal vertical movement asserted in the sequel.
The explicit place or standing reconnects the sequel's destination to the focus root.
Highness as honor keeps elevation of rank live alongside physical height.

structural_cues: The object pronoun in 19:57 immediately resumes Idris.
"مكانا" in 19:57 is tagged with the same ك-و-ن root as "كان" in 19:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct pronominal continuation, root recurrence, and vertical language; I infer that raising confirms the preceding profile. The live alternative is an independent gift with no causal relation to truthfulness or prophecy.

changed_reading.before: Idris is described in the past as truthful and prophetic.
changed_reading.after: Idris's truthful prophetic standing is immediately made positional: he is raised into a high place, rank, or both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathering statement in 19:58 includes the named prophets, then reverses the direction of prophetic communication: signs are recited to them and register as falling, prostration, and tears. Idris as "نبيا" is therefore not only an outward bearer of report but a radically receptive body whose truthful response verifies what reaches him.

activation_trace.role: Truth realized in action anchors bodily response as verification rather than emotion detached from the focus.
The divine-reporting office supplies the outward direction that the context productively reverses.
The plural prophetic class gathers Idris into the group whose response is then described.
Sound following sound supplies the serial arrival of recitation to the gathered prophets.
A manifest sign supplies the recognizable content that reaches and tests the hearer.
Audible, destabilized falling converts reception into an involuntary bodily event.
Lowering in submission gives the fall a directed relation of humility.
Tears, grief, and voice make inward reception externally legible.

structural_cues: The demonstrative opening 19:58 gathers the preceding named figures among the prophets.
The conditional sequence links recitation to immediate falling, prostration, and weeping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group reference and a recitation-response conditional; I infer that Idris participates in the reciprocal, receptive dimension of prophecy. The alternative is that the collective description does not assert an identical response for every named figure.

changed_reading.before: "نبيا" defines Idris mainly by the report he bears outward.
changed_reading.after: "نبيا" also defines Idris by what he can receive inwardly: signs become truth in his collapsing, prostrating, weeping body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the clear-road branch is peripheral to the ordinary prophetic noun; it remains anchored in "نبيا" and is activated by the packet's explicit guidance, path, and straightness cluster. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary spatial resonance, never as the lexical gloss of "نبيا".
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "نبيا" at word 8 carries a branch image of a clear road or easy ground that reaches a destination.

activation_trace.role: A clear road and easy ground supply the unusual focus image of prophecy as traversable access.
Gentle indication toward the true road activates the directional function of the peripheral focus branch.
The straight road provides an explicit context counterpart to the focus branch's route image.
Intrinsic straightness and completeness make the activated route reliable rather than merely open.
The final gathering of those guided keeps the route function live across the named prophetic sequence.

changed_reading.before: A prophet is a bearer of divine report.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, Idris as prophet can be carried as a clear, traversable route by which guidance reaches its destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because "ورفعناه مكانا عليا" strongly presents literal or rank elevation, while broadcasting news is a distant branch of the raising root. It remains valid as an adjacent resonance through the focus's uttered remembrance, written medium, and news branch; downstream prose should keep it subordinate to elevation of place or rank.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins spoken remembrance, written preservation, and "نبيا", whose root also carries consequential news.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue supplies the act by which Idris's remembered report can circulate.
Written composition supplies the durable transmission channel for that circulation.
Consequential news supplies what can be raised into wider hearing.
Literal raising controls the primary reading and keeps the broadcast resonance contained.
Broadcasting news supplies the secondary possibility that Idris's report is elevated into circulation.

changed_reading.before: The sequel raises Idris only in place or rank.
changed_reading.after: Alongside place or rank, the sequel can faintly raise Idris's news into durable circulation through remembered writing.

strongest_changes: The intensive truth predicate shifts from generic accuracy to fidelity performed across word, obligation, and act.
Remembering in the Book becomes the transmission of an elevated truthful repute, not archival storage alone.
The immediate high-place sequel makes the focus's truthful prophetic standing positional without forcing a choice between spatial height and rank.
The closing gathering reverses prophecy's direction: Idris is not only a reporter but a receiver whose body verifies recited signs.
summary.what_was_special: A very short focus verse is locally expanded by an exact earlier frame, an immediately preceding truth-promise-practice sequence, and immediate elevation and collective-response sequels. The result is a coupled mechanism of remembered truth, enacted fidelity, prophetic transmission, elevated standing, and embodied receptivity.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact 19:41/19:56 frame may signal compressed narrative equivalence or only a repeated catalogue formula.
The high place in 19:57 leaves spatial location and rank simultaneously live.
The high tongue of truth in 19:50 may calibrate Idris's remembered repute or remain specific to the earlier figures.
The clear-route and broadcast readings are branch-backed resonances but remain too peripheral to carry as primary glosses.

Kaybolan bilgiyi zihinde arama ve öğrenileni bellekte tutmak için çalışma süreçlerini kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dini açıklayan kitabı, peygamberlere indirildiğine inanılan kitapları, Kur'an'ı ve önceki kutsal kitapları aynı dalda toplar. Geçici çerçeve metinsel nesneyi doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kutsal veya vahyedilmiş sayılan kitabın kendisidir; okuma, çalışma, ibadet ya da zihinsel hatırlama eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın kutsal kitap anlamını verir; okuma veya ibadetle ilgili söz öbeklerinden yeni bir genel anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dinin hükümlerini ve açıklamalarını içeren, bir peygambere indirildiğine inanılan kutsal kitaptır. Kapsam hem Kur'an'ı hem de daha önceki kutsal kitapları içine alabilir.

facets.statement: Dinin ayrıntılarını bildiren ve ilahi kaynaklı kabul edilen kitaptır.
Kur'an ile ondan önceki peygamberlere bağlanan kutsal kitapları kapsayan bir üst ad olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dini açıklayan peygamber kitaplarını ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve kapsamı Kur'an ile önceki kutsal kitaplara kadar genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinin hükümlerini içeren peygamber kitabı genel bir tür olarak anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini açıklama, kutsal kabul edilme ve peygambere indirilme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam kitabın dini ve vahyedilmiş niteliğini zaten açıkça gösterdiğinde doğal kısa karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini içerikli ve kutsal kabul edilen kitap olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Peygambere indirilme ve önceki kitapları kapsayan üst ad olma ayrıntısını açıkça belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişinin toplum içindeki yüksek konumunu, iyi ününü, övgüyle anılmasını ve saygınlığını ortak bir sonuç alanında toplar. Geçici çerçeve bu toplumsal değer ve yayılmış tanınma bileşimini doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal anma eyleminin kendisi değil, kişinin olumlu biçimde anılmasıyla bağlantılı onur, iyi ün ve saygınlıktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın iyi ün ve onur anlamı korunur; kişi niteleyen söz öbeği bellek gücü ile iyi anılmayı kendi bağlamında birleştirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin insanlar arasında olumlu biçimde tanınmasından doğan iyi ün, onur, övgü ve yüksek saygınlıktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin toplum içinde taşıdığı onur ve yüksek saygınlıktır.
Kişinin olumlu biçimde anılmasıyla yayılan iyi ün ve övgüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar onur ve yüksek konumu, insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ün ve övgüyle birlikte tek bir olumlu toplumsal itibar alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin olumlu tanınması ile toplumsal yüksekliğini birlikte anlatmak gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Yüksek konum ve onur bileşenini tek başına açıkça belirtmez.

error_profile.loses: Adının yayılması ve övgüyle anılması yönünü açıkça kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli hak söz öbeğinde bir hakkı kayda geçiren yazılı belgeyi ve bu belgelerin çoğulunu verir. Geçici çerçeve yapıya bağlı belge anlamını eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam bağımsız bir kitap adı değildir; bir hakkı gösteren yazılı belgeyi adlandıran belirli söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız hak belgesi yapısına ve onun çoğul biçimine bağlanır; yalın köke genel belge anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hakkın varlığını, sahibini veya koşullarını yazılı olarak gösteren belge ve bu tür belgelerin çoğul adıdır.

Aynı yapının çoğul biçimi birden çok hak belgesini topluca adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli hak söz öbeğini yazılı hak belgesi olarak açıklar ve çoğul biçimin birden çok hak belgesini gösterdiğinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir hakkın yazıyla kayda geçirildiği belgeyi veya bu belgelerin çoğulunu açıklarken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belgenin belirli bir hakkı gösterme ve kanıtlama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yazılı olma niteliğini ve çoğul biçimin tarihsel yapısını açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok hakkı veya birden çok yazılı kanıtı topluca adlandıran çoğul yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Birden çok yazılı hak belgesinin topluca adlandırılmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tekil belge kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hakkı veya yükümlülüğü yazılı biçimde güvence altına alan belgeyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak hak belgesine daralır; komşu belge türlerini ve resmi kayıt eylemini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bir hakkı kanıtlar; komşu ise bir kişiye yapılacak işi önceden bildirip emanet eder.

Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici nesne merkezli çerçeve bu süreç ve yoğunluk yüzlerini açıkça kapsayacak biçimde genişletilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hatırlamanın kendisi değil, onu doğuran eylem veya araçtır; sık anma anlamı da yalnız kaynakta belirtilen biçime bağlı bir yoğunluk yüzüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hatırlatma eylemi, hatırlatıcı araç ve sık anma ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; bu yapıların hiçbiri yalın zihinsel hatırlamayla özdeşleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir bilginin yeniden zihinde belirmesini sağlamak veya buna yarayan bir işaret ya da araç sunmaktır. Belirli bir biçim ayrıca bir şeyi sıkça anmayı anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir başkasında veya kişinin kendisinde unutulmuş bilginin yeniden hatırlanmasını sağlar.
Bir ihtiyacı veya bilgiyi hatırlamaya yarayan işaret, not ya da araç olarak gerçekleşir.
Belirli bir ad biçiminde bir şeyi sık ve yoğun biçimde anma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hatırlatmayı başkasında hatırlama meydana getiren geçişli eylem ve hatırlamaya yarayan araç olarak verir; ayrıca belirli biçimde sık anma yoğunluğunu kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hatırlamayı doğuran eylemi, buna yarayan işaret veya nesneyi ve belirli biçime bağlı sık anmayı birlikte açıklamak gereken genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hatırlatıcı neden, hatırlamaya yarayan araç ve buna bağlı yoğun anma yüzlerini korur.
